introText:
You are the greatest private investigator at Othello University and have been hired to investigate a recent incident at a Phi Omega Psi house party.

Which you weren't invited to.

But it turns out that was a good thing!

A chemistry major was hired by the party's organizers to create a serum to make everyone's eyes glow in the dark. It worked great; it was like a dark room full of raccoons.

Unfortunately, it turns out that anyone who drank the serum will lose their eyesight in 2 days.

The chemist-in-training has developed a cure, but needs to know who to give it to. Thankfully, these house parties are strictly invite-only, so all you need is the list of attendees.

The chemist has paid good money to keep this quiet, so you've ~acquired~ one of the event organizer's laptops.

Find the list and pay your rent!

client.message: Remember! Time is of the essence!
client.thanks: TYSM! I wenmo'd you the rest of your payment!
client.thanks2: Update: I was able to ~discretely~ spray the cure in everybody's eyes. This could've been real bad! I promise to be more careful next time. Thanks again, see you around!
